t: Nobody is married without being asked
a: لاَ تُنْكَحُ الأَيِّمُ حَتَّى تُسْتَأْمَرَ وَلاَ تُنْكَحُ الْبِكْرُ حَتَّى تُسْتَأْذَنَ
p: Lā tunkaḥu-l-ayyimu ḥattā tustaʾmar, wa lā tunkaḥu-l-bikru ḥattā tustaʾdhan
m: A previously married woman is not given in marriage until she is consulted, and a woman who has not married before is not given in marriage until her permission is sought.
